scope.root_cause: package-vsix.js copied only the POSIX mux launcher and used swallow-tolerant existsSync+mode checks. Windows .cmd launcher was an empty stub. No end-to-end static test validated the strict no-swallow packaging logic or .cmd launcher semantics without creating dist artifacts.
changes: scripts/aiworkhub-app-server-mux.cmd: implemented Windows batch launcher that selects runtime first, dev src second, prepends PYTHONPATH, forwards %*, captures ERRORLEVEL, propagates through endlocal, exits /b 1 on missing runtime

vscode-extension/test/package-vsix.js: added MUX_LAUNCHER_CMD_SRC/DEST paths; copies both POSIX and .cmd launchers into extension/bin; chmodSync 0o755 and executable-bit check gated behind platform !== win32; uses fs.statSync + .isFile() instead of swallow-tolerant existsSync for both launchers

vscode-extension/test/mux-launcher-packaging-b1038.test.js: focused static test validates .cmd semantics (preamble, runtime-first, src-fallback, error+exit, %* forward, ERRORLEVEL capture+endlocal propagation) and strict packaging logic (both launchers copied, statSync+isFile, platform guard, no old existsSync pattern) without creating dist artifacts

acceptance_evidence.requirement: package-vsix copies both existing POSIX and new Windows launchers into extension/bin and requires both as regular files
acceptance_evidence.test: testStrictPackagingLogic — validates fs.copyFileSync for both MUX_LAUNCHER_SRC and MUX_LAUNCHER_CMD_SRC, requires muxStat.isFile() and cmdStat.isFile()

acceptance_evidence.requirement: Non-Windows uses uncaught chmodSync 0755 and strict executable verification; Windows skips only chmod/mode checks
acceptance_evidence.test: testStrictPackagingLogic — validates if (process.platform !== "win32") guards fs.chmodSync(0o755) and mode & 0o111 check

acceptance_evidence.requirement: .cmd selects packaged ../runtime first and dev ../src second, prepends PYTHONPATH, forwards %*, captures ERRORLEVEL immediately, and propagates it through endlocal
acceptance_evidence.test: testCmdSemantics — validates all .cmd content semantics including if-exist ordering, PYTHONPATH prepend, python -m %* forward, ERRORLEVEL capture, and endlocal & exit /b propagation

acceptance_evidence.requirement: Focused static test verifies strict no-swallow packaging logic and .cmd semantics without creating dist artifacts
acceptance_evidence.test: mux-launcher-packaging-b1038.test.js — reads source files only (no fs.writeFileSync or execFileSync), validates both launcher content and packaging logic statically
